response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, '') AS throws, COUNT(*) AS count FROM player_award pa INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, '')), total_awards AS (SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM award_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT throws, count, count * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_awards) AS share FROM award_counts), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM with_shares), filtered AS (SELECT throws, count, share FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) SELECT SUM(count) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) AS avg_excess FROM filtered
